name: Stabilize
description: Remove shake and weave from the picture
longDescription:
Measures how much the whole frame moves between shots and cancels it, so a shaky capture holds still. Deliberate camera movement survives: only the difference from the recent trend is removed.

Use it on telecine weave, film scans that wobble in the gate, and handheld camcorder footage. It runs last before cropping, because it shifts the picture within the frame and leaves thin empty edges — a small crop afterwards removes them.

The shift leaves thin empty edges; set Fill Exposed Edges to mirror them back in, or crop them away afterwards.

methods.name: Stab
methods.description: Motion-analysis stabilisation via MVTools. Cancels shake while leaving intended camera movement alone

ui.label: Max Horizontal Shift
ui.description: Largest sideways correction, in pixels. 0 leaves the horizontal axis alone

ui.label: Max Vertical Shift
ui.description: Largest up/down correction, in pixels. 0 leaves the vertical axis alone

ui.label: Fill Exposed Edges
ui.description: Shifting the picture leaves thin empty edges. 0 leaves them black, 1 fills top and bottom, 2 left and right, 3 all four — which saves cropping afterwards
